title: Empty WR-90 waveguide along y, 30 mm, ports on its faces across y: TE10 transmission
source: TE10 propagation in a rectangular waveguide, S21 = exp(−jβL) with β = √(k0² − (π/a)²): D. M. Pozar, Microwave Engineering, 4th ed., Wiley 2012, §3.3

quantities.reason: second-order elements, 3 mm (λg/13) on an unstructured mesh: the phase error grows with the length travelled, about 0.01° here
lossless: the discrete system conserves power to rounding; |S21| moves only by the reflection the mesh makes
the only reflection is the mesh's dispersion mismatch against the exact port condition
as at 10 GHz, with a shorter guide wavelength (λg = 29.1 mm, ten elements per wavelength)
